first_summary: The file is built on a Haiku 4.5 / Sonnet 5 / Opus 5 world: a 1x/2x/4-5x/10x ladder, a hard 200K Haiku wall, 'Haiku takes no effort', and effective-unit arithmetic from the Sonnet 5 and Opus 5 effort indices. All of it is wrong for the 5.5 generation that the aliases resolve to, and the break-evens, batch rows, 2-2.5x saving, 'wash' claim and MCP/ToolSearch rationale were computed from those stale facts. It also carries the pre-probe claims that Agent has no effort parameter and that frontmatter effort is unconfirmed, and it still stamps its provenance as 2.1.286 / 2026-10-01. The Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet price rows, the Fable and 'no index' effort rows, model-scoped caches, advisor-on-every-tier, the 'tool surface is the biggest lever' claim and inherit-follows-session survive and must not be over-corrected.
critic_summary: The first pass was thorough on the headline claims (Haiku effort, the 200K wall, the cost ladder, the cache-read inversion, the Agent-tool effort cell) but missed line-level repeats, rationale sentences built on retired arithmetic (L116, L120, L126, L156, L178, L318), the opus-alias pin advice at L23, and nearly all still-true-keep items other than a handful, so I added 25 findings and 3 disputes.
